name: toeydevelopment-skills
description: Reusable engineering, product, Flutter, and LINE development skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: toeydevelopment-skills
plugins.description: Install every Toeydevelopment skill as one Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: flutter-ddd
plugins.description: Write Flutter/Dart code following Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with Clean Architecture. BLoC, dartz Either/Failure, freezed, retrofit, injectable, auto_route.

plugins.name: flutter-responsive-ui
plugins.description: Build responsive Flutter interfaces with constraint-aware layouts, adaptive breakpoints, safe scrolling, and zero overflow errors.

plugins.name: line-dev-expert
plugins.description: Build LINE Platform applications — Messaging API bots, LIFF/Mini Apps, LINE Login, LINE Pay, Rich Menus, Flex Messages, CRM, loyalty programs, and Thailand market integrations.

plugins.name: company-craft
plugins.description: Set up and optimize AI agent companies on Paperclip. Bootstrap: analyze workspace, detect tech stack, generate agent instructions, build org chart, seed tickets. Audit: review roster, rebalance workloads, check ticket quality, suggest hires/cuts.

plugins.name: task-authoring
plugins.description: Format already-verified work as high-quality tickets that worker agents can execute efficiently. Covers Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, acceptance criteria, self-test instructions, and context optimization.

plugins.name: evidence-first-issue-authoring
plugins.description: Investigate repositories and draft or audit evidence-grounded engineering issues. Separates observations, code facts, product decisions, hypotheses, and proposals; routes unverified work to investigation or decision issues.

plugins.name: issue-intake
plugins.description: Verify and audit issues opened by non-technical authors against the code, find the parent epic, relate the issues, and return decision cards plus a visual HTML brief with a numbered decide-and-discuss block. Knowledge only.

plugins.name: spec-first-delivery
plugins.description: Documentation-first delivery pipeline. Produces ADR, PRD, diagrams, API/protobuf, anti-slop docs and a compounding LLM wiki, then a dependency-ordered task DAG, then implements with outside-in TDD in a git worktree with atomic green commits.
